units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y downward

camera.motion: static (clean background identical in frames 0 and 57 where uncovered; horizon and water boundary fixed)
camera.view: side view; boat and shark move horizontally in planes facing the camera
camera.note: Upper part: grey sky (y<567) and grey-blue sea surface (567-672). Lower part y>=673: flat blue underwater view (a separate panel/cut-away). The boat and the shark may be at different depths/scales - no perspective cue links them.

objects.name: boat
objects.description: red fishing boat, hull number 'AH805' in yellow, white wheelhouse with two windows, mast with rigging, rail aft; upper half of image
objects.visible_frames: 0-57 (stern cut by left image edge in frames 0-20; mast top cut by top image edge in all frames)
objects.reference_point: estimated origin = centre of hull bbox: x = midpoint stern..bow, y = 498.5 (hull top 357 .. keel 640). Origin not observable; x-mid of the full boat equals x-mid of the hull.
objects.motion: stationary frames 0-1 (identical), then pure horizontal translation to the right, +17.88 px/frame (std 0.04) from frame 1 to 57; no vertical motion (<0.5 px)

size_px_at_frame_57.mast_top: above image (y<0); total height NOT measurable

objects.name: shark
objects.description: grey/white shark, lower (underwater) half of image, swimming leftward, head pointing left
objects.reference_point: mask centroid (visible centre); bbox centre also given
objects.motion: stationary frames 0-1, then horizontal translation to the left, -10.73 px/frame mean (per-frame centroid noise ~0.4 px), y constant 905.5

objects.name: sea_surface_horizon
objects.description: horizon line between grey sky and sea surface

objects.name: underwater_panel
objects.description: uniform blue underwater region, y 673-1079, full width

events.event: both boat and shark start moving
events.note: frames 0 and 1 identical; first displacement between frame 1 and 2

events.event: boat stern enters image (whole boat visible)
boat bow tip (bbox x1) reaches shark centroid x
events.note: crossing at ~frame 39.96; mean hull bow edge (rows 400-600, bow_edge_x_subpix) crosses at ~frame 41.9

events.event: boat reference point (hull centre) and shark centroid have equal x (vertically aligned)
end of clip, both still moving
